messages:
zoe: Quick convo: we need a small prescriptive SLA for "pin" customers so CS has a clean offer. Not a full product yet, just a landing contract + rollback playbook.

marco: Agreed. Customers want predictability. Proposal: 3 SKUs - Trial(30d), Standard(90d), Enterprise(negotiated). Each SKU has explicit limits and a built-in rollback SLA.

dee: From infra: important to include memory reservation and per-tenant caps. Suggested defaults:
- per_tenant_pins: 2
- global_soft_cap: 120
- reserved_gb_per_pin: 1.2
- default_ttl_days: 90
If soft_cap breached, auto-waitlist and notify infra.

lin: ML quality gates for Standard/Enterprise: semantic pass rate >= 97% on curated prompts, embedding drift (mean cosine) <= 0.025, p95 latency delta <= 12%. Trial lane can be looser (semantic >=95%, drift <=0.04).

zoe: Rollback playbook (draft):
1) Canary at 5% for 24h. Monitor: user_error_rate, semantic_regressions, p95 latency.
2) Auto-rollback triggers: user_error_rate delta >0.5% absolute OR semantic_regressions >3% over 1h.
3) Manual pause: product/infra/legal can pause sunset if customer impact noted.

marco: We should encode a short machine-readable policy on the model page so CS can copy into RFPs. Example snippet: 
```
pin_policy: {
  lanes: [trial, standard, enterprise],
  default_ttl: 90,
  per_tenant_limit: 2,
  rollback_triggers: {error_delta:0.005, semantic_delta:0.03}
}
```

legal: Draft contract clause: "Redwood may propose model changes; customers may request time-limited pinning. Extended pins beyond default TTL may incur surcharge and require contract amendment. Redwood will provide migration assistance per the selected SKU." Will iterate.

dee: Ops note: add expiry reminders at 60d, 30d, 14d, 7d, 1d and a one-click migrate in console. Also include "soft cap" telemetry alert at 80% of global_soft_cap.

zoe: CS negotiation playbook bullets: offer standard lane + 2-week token credit; for enterprise, require cost-pass-through and a migration workshop. For customers insisting on >12mo, require a signed addendum.

ops-bot: INFO: current_pinned_variants=39; global_soft_cap=120; headroom_ok.

lin: CI template for approving pins: run 200 curated prompts, compute embedding drift on golden vectors (n=1000), and run a short p95 synthetic at requested QPS for 15m. Include artifact link in approval request.

marco: Action items:
- Legal: clause + addendum template (ETA 2d)
- Dee: infra quota + expiry reminders + billing hook (ETA 3d)
- Lin: CI template + regression sampler spec (ETA 3d)
- Zoe: console mock + CS script (ETA 4d)

zoe: I'll file RW-PL-8001 and attach these items. If no objections I'll convert to an epic. :white_check_mark:

marco: No objections from infra.

lin: No objections from ML.

legal: Ok from legal for initial wording.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-PL-8001 and assigned to @zoe."
